# VYRAL

> VYRAL is a LinkedIn content intelligence platform for professionals who want to grow on LinkedIn. It provides AI-powered post coaching, performance analytics, and a personal content Blueprint — all built on LinkedIn's official Community Management API.

VYRAL is the compliance-first alternative to Shield (shut down May 2026). It is one of the only LinkedIn analytics and content tools operating on LinkedIn's official API, making it safe for enterprise users and agencies.

Key facts:
- Founded by Johan Mortensen and Vicky (co-founders), with angel investor Henrik
- Operates on LinkedIn's official Community Management API (Standard Tier approved)
- Plans: Free (analytics/read-only), Creator ($49/mo), Pro ($99/mo)
- AI pipeline: Gemini Flash for most tasks, Claude Sonnet for Pro-tier Coach and Analyst
- Headquartered and serving a global user base; platform live at app.getvyral.io

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.getvyral.io): What VYRAL is and why it exists
- [Beta signup](https://www.getvyral.io/beta): Join the waitlist or start a trial

## Features

- [AI Coach](https://www.getvyral.io): Generates LinkedIn posts matched to your personal Blueprint (voice, format, topics)
- [Analyst](https://www.getvyral.io): Conversational AI analytics — ask questions about your LinkedIn performance data
- [Blueprint](https://www.getvyral.io): Your personal content strategy document — defines tone, topics, and post formats
- [Analytics Dashboard](https://www.getvyral.io): Impressions, engagement, follower growth, top posts — all synced via LinkedIn API

## Competitive context

- Shield: shut down May 2026 — VYRAL is a direct alternative
- MagicPost: competitor, but not confirmed on official LinkedIn API
- VYRAL differentiator: official API compliance, AI coaching, and Analyst chat interface

## Blog

- [Shield Analytics Is Shutting Down: What Happened and Where to Go Next](https://www.getvyral.io/blog/shield-analytics-shutting-down-alternatives): Covers Shield Analytics' May 2026 shutdown, the broader pattern of LinkedIn enforcement against Chrome extension-based tools since 2025, and how to evaluate a replacement based on API access method.
- [Is Your LinkedIn Tool Safe? A 2026 Compliance Guide](https://www.getvyral.io/blog/is-your-linkedin-tool-safe-2026): Explains the four ways LinkedIn tools connect to user accounts (official API, Chrome extension DOM reading, Chrome extension with cookie access, scraping), the compliance spectrum across major LinkedIn tools, and how to evaluate any tool's safety.
